hypothesis: compare.msg_send submit_to_ack_ms is gated by the TUI submit's daemon round trip on the key/render path (Enter -> first output ~35ms fresh-measure, TS ~1.2ms); TS onSubmit resolves agentConnection.prompt off the render path (async handler, editor clears before the await), so the port must queue the submit and fold the outcome back to reach TS-class latency.
approach: pa-tui session_ui.rs + interactive.rs: send_prompt queues a PromptOrder on an ordered unbounded channel; one long-lived prompt_submit_worker drains FIFO with a single in-flight request (wire order = submit order, TS single-threaded event-loop parity); PromptSubmitNote outcomes fold back through the run loop's select arm into apply_prompt_outcome (same admission bookkeeping + error ladder as the inline await: one-rebind+replay via attach_session(&durable, DockFold::FirstFrame), timeout note, direct-sent note, refusal -> error row + retain_rejected_draft); submit-time completion watermark (turn_ends_seen/expected_turn_end, Kevin-authored on the lane) keeps a late ACK from re-arming an already-settled turn (fixed an 84x live-runs slowdown 30.08s->0.36s); park the closed headless ui_rx arm once headless_done (the gdb root cause of the outlived-submit e2e hang: closed receiver + active turn + no deadline hot-spins the select); WaitIdle barrier + headless exit gate + busy guards (/update, /nightly, /reload) read prompt_submits_in_flight/work_in_flight.
parity_notes: TS citations: interactive-mode.ts:5150 (onSubmit async), :5164 (generation bump), :5687 (editor clears before await), :5714-5718 (await agentConnection.prompt, queueIfBusy: true), :5720-5743 (rejection ladder + retainSubmittedDraft), :4806-4821 (retainSubmittedDraft). Wire envelope unchanged (DaemonCommand::Prompt incl. rlm_notice_nonce; queue_if_busy: true); session JSONL written by the daemon, unchanged (e2e ordering tests assert on it). Terminal mode untouched (headless_done is headless-driver-only). DISCLOSED frame-sequence difference (adversarial audit pending): under a >400ms ACK stall (observed once under 16-way battery load; isolated rerun PASS; pure-base battery PASS same test), the bang card can mount before the ACK outcome arms the loader, so the pending-regime frame lacks the loader row (bash_bang_headless a_bang_during_a_streaming_turn_holds_then_flushes, panicked at :851 'the working loader row'); TS's bang path (interactive-mode.ts:5582-5644) checks isBashRunning + side-question state ONLY - no isStreaming/inputSubmissionsPending gate - and TS's isStreaming is event-driven (:3263, :3350), so TS would also run the bang while the prompt await pends; the old blocking submit guaranteed the frame order, the backgrounded one does not under pathological ACK latency.
